description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the CheckLoanRepaymentOverdueBusinessStep class, verifying its behavior in raising business events when loan repayment installments become overdue based on configured days.

classes.name: CheckLoanRepaymentOverdueBusinessStepTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for CheckLoanRepaymentOverdueBusinessStep, verifying overdue loan installments trigger appropriate business events.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes thread local context and the class under test before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread local context after each test.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Static setup for mocking MoneyHelper static methods before all tests.

methods.name: destruct
methods.description: Closes static mock for MoneyHelper after all tests.

methods.name: givenLoanWithInstallmentOverdueAfterConfiguredDaysWhenStepExecutionThenBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Test that verifies a business event is triggered when a loan installment is overdue beyond configured days.

methods.name: givenLoanWithNoInstallmentOverdueAfterConfiguredDaysWhenStepExecutionThenNoBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Test that ensures no event occurs if installments are not overdue.

methods.name: givenLoanWithInstallmentOverdueAfterConfiguredDaysButInstallmentPaidOffWhenStepExecutionThenNoBusinessEvent
methods.description: Verifies no event is raised if overdue installment is paid off.

methods.name: givenLoanWithInstallmentOverdueAfterConfiguredDaysInLoanProductWhenStepExecutionThenBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Checks event raising when overdue days are specified in the loan product rather than global config.

methods.name: givenActiveLoanWithZeroOutstandingWhenStepExecutionThenNoBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Ensures no event is triggered for active loans with zero outstanding balance.

methods.name: givenActiveLoanWithNonZeroOutstandingWhenStepExecutionThenBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Verifies event triggering for active loans with non-zero outstanding balance over due days.

methods.name: givenSubmittedLoanWhenStepExecutionThenNoBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Ensures no event for loans with submitted status.

methods.name: givenApprovedLoanWhenStepExecutionThenNoBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Ensures no event for loans with approved status.

methods.name: buildInstallment
methods.description: Helper to create mocked installment with specified characteristics for tests.
